d: More than 4.3 million toothpaste tubes have been recalled in the U.S. over potential health risks. Over 76% of the affected products were marketed for children. From bubble gum to strawberry and ice cream flavours, the recall covers 17 varieties flagged for failing to meet manufacturing standards. So, which toothpastes are affected, and what should parents look out for? Palki Sharma tells you.
